source: OpenAlex API /works (IDs written from the response by scripts/run_search.py)
query: ("platform labour" OR "platform labor" OR "platform work") AND (city OR urban OR street)
filter: title_and_abstract.search.exact:("platform labour" OR "platform labor" OR "platform work") AND (city OR urban OR street),is_retracted:false,publication_year:2022-2026
oql:
get works where retracted is (false)
  and year >= (2022)
  and year <= (2026)
  and title-abstract has (("platform labor" OR "platform labour" OR "platform work") AND ("city" OR "street" OR "urban"))
